reference_sql:
WITH visitor_sessions AS (  -- one row per session of a signed-up visitor, up to the signup
  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.session_id, s.session_start, s.utm_source
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  WHERE s.session_start <= u.signup_ts
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per session of a signed-up visitor, up to the signup
  SELECT visitor_id, utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start, session_id) AS first_no,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start DESC, session_id) AS last_no
  FROM visitor_sessions
)
SELECT utm_source,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_no = 1) AS first_touch,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_no = 1) AS last_touch
FROM ranked
WHERE first_no = 1 OR last_no = 1
GROUP BY utm_source

WITH visitor_sessions AS (  -- one row per session of a signed-up visitor, up to the signup
  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.session_id, s.session_start, s.utm_source
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  WHERE s.session_start <= u.signup_ts
),
first_ts AS (  -- one row per signed-up visitor
  SELECT visitor_id, MIN(session_start) AS first_start, MAX(session_start) AS last_start
  FROM visitor_sessions
  GROUP BY visitor_id
),
picks AS (  -- one row per signed-up visitor
  SELECT f.visitor_id,
         (SELECT MIN(vs.session_id) FROM visitor_sessions vs WHERE vs.visitor_id = f.visitor_id AND vs.session_start = f.first_start) AS first_id,
         (SELECT MIN(vs.session_id) FROM visitor_sessions vs WHERE vs.visitor_id = f.visitor_id AND vs.session_start = f.last_start) AS last_id
  FROM first_ts f
),
touches AS (  -- one row per first or last touch of a signed-up visitor
  SELECT vs.utm_source, 1 AS is_first, 0 AS is_last FROM picks p JOIN visitor_sessions vs ON vs.session_id = p.first_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT vs.utm_source, 0, 1 FROM picks p JOIN visitor_sessions vs ON vs.session_id = p.last_id
)
SELECT utm_source, SUM(is_first) AS first_touch, SUM(is_last) AS last_touch
FROM touches
GROUP BY utm_source

  SELECT s.visitor_id, s.session_id, s.session_start, s.utm_source
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN signups u ON u.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  WHERE s.session_start <= u.signup_ts
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per session of a signed-up visitor, up to the signup
  SELECT visitor_id, utm_source,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start, session_id) AS first_no,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start DESC, session_id) AS last_no
  FROM visitor_sessions
)
SELECT utm_source,
       SUM(CASE WHEN first_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_touch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN last_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_touch
FROM ranked
WHERE first_no = 1 OR last_no = 1
GROUP BY utm_source

solver.query:
WITH s AS (SELECT se.visitor_id, se.session_id, se.utm_source, se.session_start FROM sessions se JOIN signups su ON su.visitor_id = se.visitor_id WHERE se.session_start <= su.signup_ts),
r AS (SELECT utm_source, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start, session_id) AS f, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start DESC, session_id) AS l FROM s)
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f = 1) AS first_touch, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l = 1) AS last_touch
FROM r WHERE f = 1 OR l = 1 GROUP BY utm_source
